name: Thabo Moloi
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport began in a small township outside Johannesburg, where he spent countless hours tinkering with his uncle's old bakkie. This early exposure to mechanics sparked a lifelong fascination with how things work, leading him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering. After graduating, he landed an apprenticeship at a local racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for composite materials and their application in high-performance vehicles.

He joined ART Grand Prix five years ago, where his meticulous approach to composite repair and fabrication has earned him a reputation as a reliable and skilled technician. Thabo is known for his ability to diagnose complex issues and develop innovative solutions, often exceeding expectations in terms of durability and performance. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor under pressure and his unwavering commitment to quality, making him a valuable asset to the team.

Thabo's perfectionist nature and relentless pursuit of improvement set him apart. He is always seeking new techniques and materials to enhance the performance and safety of the race cars, ensuring ART Grand Prix maintains a competitive edge.

physical.description: Thabo is a lean man of medium height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when concentrating.
Insists on using a specific type of microfiber cloth for polishing composite surfaces.
